name: Nuclear risk
summary: No US–Russia arms-control limits; China rejects trilateral talks; North Korean launches
state: New START expired in February 2026 with no replacement. The five nuclear-weapon states consulted in New York in early October, but China said on 16 Oct that trilateral talks are not realistic (Arms Control Association). North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov (Japan Times). No nuclear test or change in alert levels had been reported as of 6 Nov.
for_you: No public action needed; official guidance would come from national emergency agencies.
rubric_hit: Arms-control lapse without replacement + explicit threats = Watch

sources.title: Arms Control Association — Nuclear-weapon states consult as Trump talks denuclearization
Japan Times — North Korea fires off 'several' missiles

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
